drivingQuestion: Does one covering suffice for all the blood of animals and birds slaughtered in one place?
outcomeNote: A mishna stating the rule and R׳ Yehuda's dissent; the derivations for both are given in the gemara that follows.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שָׁחַט מֵאָה חַיּוֹת בְּמָקוֹם אֶחָד – כִּסּוּי אֶחָד לְכוּלָּן, מֵאָה עוֹפוֹת בְּמָקוֹם אֶחָד – כִּסּוּי אֶחָד לְכוּלָּן, חַיָּה וָעוֹף בְּמָקוֹם אֶחָד – כִּסּוּי אֶחָד לְכוּלָּן. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: שָׁחַט חַיָּה – יְכַסֶּנָּה, וְאַחַר כָּךְ יִשְׁחוֹט אֶת הָעוֹף.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one «slaughtered one hundred undomesticated animals in one place, one covering» of the blood suffices «for all» the animals and there is no obligation to cover the blood of each animal separately. Likewise, if one slaughtered «one hundred birds in one place, one covering» of the blood suffices «for all» the birds. If one slaughtered «an undomesticated animal and a bird in one place, one covering for all of» the blood is sufficient. «Rabbi Yehuda says:» If one «slaughtered an undomesticated animal, he should cover its» blood immediately «and» only «thereafter he should slaughter the bird.»

moves.cueHe: שחט מאה חיות במקום אחד – כסוי אחד לכולן
moves.summary: one covering suffices for all blood shed in one place, animals and birds alike
moves.about: whether the blood of an undomesticated animal and of a bird slaughtered in one place may be covered with a single covering, or the animal's blood must be covered before the bird is slaughtered

moves.cueHe: רבי יהודה אומר: שחט חיה – יכסנה
moves.summary: R׳ Yehuda requires the animal's blood to be covered before the bird is slaughtered

edges.cueHe: רבי יהודה אומר: שחט חיה – יכסנה, ואחר כך ישחוט את העוף
edges.about: whether the blood of an undomesticated animal and of a bird slaughtered in one place may be covered with a single covering, or the animal's blood must be covered before the bird is slaughtered
